title: Spark sound recipe, version 1
description: A guitar sound for Positive Grid Spark amps, described by model and settings. Model ids and parameter keys are in spark-catalog.json. AmpBench checks the parts this schema cannot, such as which keys a model has: AmpBench --recipe-check <file>.

name.description: At most 31 bytes; umlauts count twice. The amp shows it.

bpm.description: Tempo for delays and effects with sync on.

notes.description: Why the sound is set up this way and what to adjust by ear.

chain.description: A place left out is switched off.

model.description: A model id from spark-catalog.json for this place, exact spelling.

settings.description: Parameter key to value. Knobs: 0 to 10. Switches: true/false or the off/on label. Choices: an option label. A key left out keeps the amp's start value.
